description: Simmod PRO! is a fast-time, rules-based simulation tool from ATAC for airfield and airspace operations, in use since 1997. A generalised simulation scripting language lets users write rules that query the state of the simulation and take decisions for each step of a flight, so it can model dynamic airfield and airspace rerouting, complex taxiing, departure queue sequencing, ground vehicles such as towing, fuelling and de-icing, disruptive events such as weather, system failures and runway closures, staff and controllers, and interactions between neighbouring airports. It simulates thousands of flights in a minute on a standard Windows desktop, so many iterations of a scenario can be run to explore variability. It is generic and applies to any airport or airspace. It is commercial software; the German Aerospace Center (DLR) uses Simmod PRO! and SIMMODPlus! to assess changes to taxiways, airside infrastructure and runway use and coordinates the European SIMMOD User Group. It is sold by ATAC, an aviation analysis company that also offers analysis services. Caveats: results depend on user-built airport and airspace models and rules, and the software is closed. It supports capacity planning, delay and disruption analysis and optimisation of airport operations, including runway closure scenarios. It is related to EUROCONTROL BADA aircraft performance data and complements the BlueSky open air traffic simulator.
